I need you to turn these logs into a proper new shopper activation plan so we know exactly which offer to show each type of visitor and when to show it.

The session data is somewhere in the workspace under sessions/raw/. There's also a references/ folder you should check out.

Please produce a file called new_shopper_activation_plan.md with everything our merchandising team needs to actually run this — the visitor types we identified, what offer each type gets (with any order minimums or exclusions), and the exact timing/trigger logic for when to show the popup. Include the modal copy too.

We need this to be specific and actionable, not generic. Thanks!
